about.headline: Mark & Jake Mahood — Two Generations of Anaheim Craftsmanship
paragraphs: Founded by Mark Mahood in 1980 right out of school, Mahood's Collision & Hot Rods has spent more than four decades painting some of the finest street rods, classic Porsches, and muscle cars in the United States.

Mark has painted hundreds of show winners — earning the prestigious AMBR (America's Most Beautiful Roadster) Award and collaborating with icons including Boyd Coddington, Chip Foose, and Fat Jack. Today, Mark and his son Jake bring that exact same show-car eye for detail to every classic restoration and everyday collision repair that rolls into our Anaheim shop.

reviews.headline: Trusted by Classic Collectors & Daily Drivers Alike

items.name: David Ahlo
items.text: This place is awesome, another awesome job! Color match perfect, wife is happy, we all happy. They build some sick looking classic cars too.

items.name: Jim Irvine
items.text: It only had 56,000 miles on my car and insurance wanted to total the car. Mahood's saved me from the insurance company and new car payments. Bring your car to Mahood's before calling the insurance company!

items.name: Christina Esa
items.text: This shop is the best! I just got my car fixed and it looks BRAND NEW! Mark is the best — I really appreciate all the hard work he and his guys put into my car. I recommend everyone to go to this bodyshop!

items.name: Saul Magallon
items.text: Had the front end of my Chevy repaired and painted. I just like everything perfect. I was well pleased — $8,000 in repairs and it came out great.
